name: insert_count_consistency
verification_script:
import requests,sys,time,uuid
BASE='{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'
c='test_insert_count'
r=requests.delete(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
r=requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema',json={'class':c,'vectorizer':'none','vectorIndexConfig':{'distance':'cosine','efConstruction':128},'properties':[{'name':'text','dataType':['text']}]})
assert r.status_code==200,f'create failed: {r.text}'
time.sleep(0.5)
for i in range(5):
    requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/objects',json={'class':c,'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'vector':[0.1*(i+1),0.2*(i+1),0.3*(i+1),0.4*(i+1)],'properties':{'text':f'item{i}'}})
time.sleep(1)
r2=requests.get(f'{BASE}/v1/objects?class={c}')
count=r2.json().get('totalResults',-1)
if count!=5:print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] insert 5 objects but totalResults={count}');sys.exit(1)
else:print(f'totalResults consistent: {count}');sys.exit(0)

name: search_score_ordering
verification_script:
import requests,sys,time,uuid
BASE='{{TESTVDB_DB_URL}}'
c='test_search_order'
r=requests.delete(f'{BASE}/v1/schema/{c}')
r=requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/schema',json={'class':c,'vectorizer':'none','vectorIndexConfig':{'distance':'cosine','efConstruction':128},'properties':[{'name':'text','dataType':['text']}]})
assert r.status_code==200,f'create failed: {r.text}'
time.sleep(0.5)
for i in range(5):
    requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/objects',json={'class':c,'id':str(uuid.uuid4()),'vector':[0.1*(i+1),0.2*(i+1),0.3*(i+1),0.4*(i+1)],'properties':{'text':f'item{i}'}})
time.sleep(1)
q='{Get{'+c+'(nearVector:{vector:[0.5,0.5,0.5,0.5],certainty:0.0}limit:10){_additional{distance}}}}'
r2=requests.post(f'{BASE}/v1/graphql',json={'query':q})
assert r2.status_code==200,f'search failed: {r2.text}'
items=r2.json().get('data',{}).get('Get',{}).get(c,[])
distances=[float(item.get('_additional',{}).get('distance',0)) for item in items]
for i in range(len(distances)-1):
    if distances[i]>distances[i+1]:print(f'[DEFECT: STATE_LOGIC_VIOLATION] distances not ascending (smaller=more similar for cosine): {distances}');sys.exit(1)
print(f'distances correctly ascending: {distances[:3]}...');sys.exit(0)
expected_outcome: cosine search results distance values are in ascending order (smaller distance = more similar)
